title_en: Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Marriage and Family Part of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 21 In a divorce action, where one spouse has evidence proving that during the marriage, he/she performed more obligations such as raising children, caring for the elderly, or assisting the other spouse's work, and requests compensation from the other spouse in accordance with Article 1088 of the Civil Code, the People's Court may determine the amount of compensation by comprehensively considering factors such as the time and energy invested in performing the corresponding obligations, the impact on both spouses, the paying spouse's ability to bear, and the per capita disposable income of local residents.

Article 22 In a divorce action, where one spouse is in financial difficulty due to old age, disability, serious illness, or other such circumstances, and requests appropriate assistance from the other spouse who is capable of bearing it in accordance with Article 1090 of the Civil Code, the People's Court may, based on the request of the party and in light of the property status of the other spouse, grant support according to law.
Article 23 These Interpretations shall come into force as of February 1, 2025.
